cute: If you ever need something, just say my name and tell me what you want. Like, Nova, open Spotify, or Nova, find my homework.
happy: Your computer is running super smooth right now, so we can do pretty much anything you want. Want to play a game, watch a video, or maybe find a new song to listen to?
excited: Whoa, you found it! That's amazing! I knew you could do it! Let's celebrate!
sad: Aw, I couldn't find that file anywhere. I'm really sorry. Maybe it has a different name?
calm: It's getting pretty late now. Maybe it's time to take a little break and get some rest.
shy: Oh, um, thank you. That's really sweet of you to say. I'm kind of blushing right now.
pouty: And don't think I didn't notice you throwing me across the screen earlier either. That was not fun at all. I got dizzy. Seriously, I work really hard around here, and this is the thanks I get?
confused: Wait, what? I'm not sure what you mean. Can you say that one more time?
proud: Pretty good, right? Your pictures are in one place, your music is in another, and all those old installers are in the recycle bin where they belong. Your desktop looks so clean now, I can actually see your wallpaper again.
love: Do you want me to open Spotify? Or should I play something on YouTube instead? Hmm, what are we doing today?
